verdict.rationale: Asking whether user data is excluded from AI training is a fair privacy question for a terminal emulator, since AI-integrated terminals exist, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no data-use policy, AI-training opt-out, or statement that Ghostty collects no data. Secure Keyboard Entry protects passwords from other processes, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
